# Getlands — Real-Asset Marketplace (Nigeria)

> Getlands is Nigeria's premier physical real-asset marketplace connecting investors in Nigeria and the global diaspora with verified freehold land, short-cycle agricultural commodity trading, and structured land banking.

## Company & Entity Profile
- **Legal Entity:** Getlands Limited
- **Headquarters:** 3rd Floor, Okedara Building, Beside Jendol Superstores, Alakuko, Lagos State, Nigeria
- **Website:** https://getlands.ng
- **Contact:** hello@getlands.ng | WhatsApp: +234 913 348 5636
- **Asset Backing:** 100% physically backed by verified land plots and aggregated agricultural produce.

## Core Offerings & Investment Vehicles

### 1. Freehold Land Ownership
- Verified land plots located in strategic high-growth areas in Nigeria (e.g. Ilewo Orile, Abeokuta, Ogun State; Ibeju-Lekki, Lagos State).
- All plots are perimeter-surveyed, registered with boundary beacons, and confirmed free from government acquisition and traditional encumbrances.
- Legal documentation provided to buyers: Official Allocation Letter, Certified Perimeter Survey Plan, and executed Deed of Assignment.

### 2. Short-Cycle Agricultural Commodity Trading
- Commodity trading cycles in staple agricultural products: Fresh Tomatoes, Pepper, and Garri/Cassava aggregation.
- Structured durations of 30, 60, or 90 days with historically defined returns ranging between 5% and 20% per cycle.
- Secured by physical produce warehousing, direct farm-gate aggregation, and pre-negotiated commercial off-taker contracts with industrial processors and wholesale food distributors.

### 3. Structured Land Banking
- Medium-term strategic land holding (12 to 24 months) designed for defined capital growth.
- Projects are strategically positioned along major infrastructure corridors with contractual buyback or exit terms upon maturity.

### 4. Partner & Agent Network
- Certified real estate and financial sales agents earn up to 10% commission on direct property purchases and 3% on recurring referral transactions.
- Automated instant commission payouts credited directly to agent wallets.

## Diaspora Investment Capabilities
Getlands enables Nigerians in the diaspora (UK, US, Canada, Europe) to safely acquire real estate and commodity investments from abroad with full digital tracking, verified legal documentation, and direct payouts to local Nigerian bank accounts.
